program.TS.description: A study program that produces internationally standard graduates who are competent in applying knowledge in the development of civil engineering technology and able to apply it in sustainable development in island regions to meet the demands of dynamic global changes.
program.AR.description: Become a maritime architecture study program based on local wisdom with global competitiveness that supports sustainable coastal development.
program.SI.description: As a bachelor's program that produces quality graduates in the field of Information Systems through education, research, and community service, at the national and international level in 2021.
program.TI.description: As a bachelor's program that produces quality graduates in the field of information technology, especially cloud technology and security, through education, research, and community service, at the national and international level in 2021.
program.MN.description: As an internationally standard Bachelor of Management program in producing graduates who have leadership and entrepreneurial spirit, are competent in the field of industrial relations, corporate finance, business-to-consumer marketing, and are responsive in anticipating dynamic global changes.
program.AK.description: As a study program that produces professional graduates in the field of financial accounting according to international standards with leadership and entrepreneurial spirit and is able to keep up with dynamic global changes.
program.PR.description: Become a tourism study program with international quality standards that produces science and technology and graduates who are able to keep up with the dynamics of tourism changes at the national and international levels.
program.MM.description: As a study program with international quality standards that produces quality graduates with leadership and entrepreneurial spirit and competence in international management at the managerial level.
program.IH.description: As a Study Program with international quality standards that produces law graduates who can meet the dynamic changes in business law in national and international contexts.
program.MH.description: As a study program with international quality standards that produces quality graduates who are able to keep up with the dynamics of business law changes at the national and international levels.
program.PBI.description: Become a bachelor's program that produces graduates with superior competence in the field of English language education that is dynamic and based on Edutechnopreneur (education, technology, and entrepreneurship) in accordance with international quality standards.
program.BIO.description: The Biology study program produces graduates who master biological sciences, are research-oriented, and are able to contribute in the fields of biotechnology, conservation, and management of natural biological resources at the national and international levels.
program.GIZ.description: The Nutrition study program aims to produce graduates who are competent in nutrition science, able to design and manage community and clinical nutrition programs, and play an active role in improving nutritional status at the national and international levels.
program.KED.description: The Medicine study program produces doctors who are professional, ethical, and globally minded, able to provide excellent health services and contribute to the development of medical science and public health.
